54.8% late, flat for 3 years

What it shows
  • 36,048 of 65,752 orders late

Dashboard analysis | Shipping modes

Shipping mode decides lateness

What it shows
  • First Class: promised 1 day, takes 2, 95.3% late
  • Same Day orders after 12:00 are always late
  • Same pattern in every market
  • Standard Class is the most reliable: 38.1%
